column1: # Each row: FILE <TAB> NORMALIZED-SNIPPET-KEY <TAB> STATUS <TAB> REASON
#   STATUS = SAFE (judged a non-bug — wrong-type result can't crash) | BUG (open).
# A typed-fallback JSON.parse NOT listed here reads as NEW and trips `--check`,
# forcing a human to judge: can a stored value of the WRONG TYPE (corrupt/legacy/
# tampered) survive the parse and crash a downstream array op (.map/.length/
# for..of/new Set), with no Array.isArray guard and no caller-side try/catch?
#   • SAFE if: Array.isArray/typeof guard after the parse, OR object-shape store
#     read only via property access/spread (tolerates any type — no throw), OR the
#     iteration runs inside a try/catch that contains the throw.
#   • BUG if: the raw result is returned/iterated with no type guard and reaches a
#     load-time array op outside any try/catch (white-screens the tool).
# Baseline (2026-06-29, iteration #11): all 33 live sites judged SAFE — the vein
# is clean; this gate is forward-looking, to catch the NEXT one Johnny ships.

reef kill-store load; now guarded by Array.isArray(v) before new Set(v) AND wrapped in try/catch, so any wrong-type (number/object/string/null) falls back to the empty Set — keys never match a real frameKey, no crash, no wrong cull.

reef per-frame framing load; guarded by `raw && typeof raw === 'object'` then EACH entry validated with Number.isFinite(s/x/y) before it's kept (and clamped) — a wrong-type value (array/number/string) yields zero kept entries, never iterated unsafely; parse in try/catch.

readJSON now type-matches its fallback: an array fallback returns only Array.isArray(v) (else fallback) so the kill-store feeding new Set(...) can never get a non-iterable; an object fallback returns only a plain non-array object so framing[m.file] reads stay safe; parse in try/catch. Wrong-type stored values degrade to the fallback, no crash.

legacy one-time migration; parse is in its own try/catch (empty catch keeps camera=null) and the result is only spread into state.camera and stored/applied as an object — never iterated (.map/.length/for..of/new Set), so a wrong-type stored value cannot crash a downstream array op.

burgundy offline note-queue read (queuedNotes); now guarded by Array.isArray(v) after the parse — a corrupt-but-valid non-array store (number/object/string) degrades to [], so queueNote's q.push and flushNoteQueue's for..of stay safe; parse in try/catch.

burgundy TTS paragraph->mp3 URL cache read (ttsUrlMap); guarded by `v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)` after the parse so a corrupt-but-valid non-object store (null/array/number/string) degrades to {} — map[key] reads and Object.keys stay crash-safe; parse in try/catch.
